Subject: Project trajectory playbook — seed template and initial doc draft

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for the time on Thursday. As discussed, I’m sharing a compact "Project Trajectory Playbook" template that we typically use to align stakeholders, run a 30–60 day technical evaluation, and define acceptance criteria for the pilot. The doc is intentionally opinionated so it surfaces the minimum milestones teams need to hit before a production decision.

Attached: project-trajectory-playbook-template.gdoc (seed), playbook-exec-summary.slides (2 slides) and a simple MAP checklist (MAP-weekly-acceptance-checklist.xlsx). I also dropped the editable Google Doc link below so your team can co-edit.

Key asks for the first pass:
- Can you confirm the primary stakeholders on your side (eng/product/security/procurement)?
- Any non-negotiable dates we should respect (quarterly freeze, compliance window)?
- Would you prefer a 21-day rapid pilot or a 45–60 day evaluation? We can adapt the milestones.

Proposed next steps (if this looks good):
1) You add stakeholders in the doc this week.
2) We co-edit acceptance criteria and sign off on the MAP by Tue, Jul 28.
3) Joint kickoff week of Aug 3 and a weekly 30-minute sync.

Links:
- Project Trajectory Playbook (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2bPlaybookSeedLink
- Executive slides (seed): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1B3cPlaybookSlides

Attachment stubs:
- project-trajectory-playbook-template.gdoc (Google Doc)
- playbook-exec-summary.slides (Google Slides)
- MAP-weekly-acceptance-checklist.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks — I’ve kept Jordan and Neha in the loop for scheduling and technical checks.

Best,

Thanks Lisa — great to meet the procurement team. Quick suggestions from our side to make the MAP execution-ready: 

- Suggested compact success metrics (to include in the MAP):
  • Latency P95 for inference on representative dataset (target: <= 250ms)
  • Token cost per 1k in the pilot traffic profile (budget target)
  • End-to-end feature coverage (list of X features validated)
  • Data privacy checks (no persistent storage of PII unless agreed)

- Recommended timeline for procurement checks: 7–10 business days to review standard SOW and security addendum; if there’s an internal governance committee expect up to 3 weeks. If procurement can indicate which documents they need (SLA, SOC2 scope, data flow diagram) we’ll surface them immediately.

- For the 30-day pilot: we usually split into three 10-day sprints — week 0: setup and smoke tests, week 1–2: feature validation + metrics collection, week 3: acceptance and production-readiness checklist. If you want a 45/60 day cadence we can add deeper integration and load tests.

I added a short 'pilot metrics' table to the doc. Jordan
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

2) Procurement: Jordan and I can provide the following ASAP: standard SOW stub, SOC 2 scope summary, and a pointer to our data flow diagram. If there’s a specific security questionnaire please share and we’ll fill it out.
